While profitability is moderate with an EBIT margin of 10.52% and retained earnings are substantial at $20,151 million, the current ratio of 1.22 is only marginally adequate, and the implied interest coverage is likely poor due to high debt levels. These factors place the issuer in the speculative grade range, specifically B-, reflecting high credit risk but some capacity to meet obligations.

DECISION: B-
